Q1.problem_type_and_essence: supervised semantic segmentation of thin fracture pixels under structured image artifacts

input_target_constraints.input: original borehole unfolded RGB/gray images and pixel masks
input_target_constraints.decision: binary mask at original image size
input_target_constraints.objective: maximize fracture-region IoU/F1/recall while controlling false positives
hard_constraints: no patch leakage across original images/boreholes
all preprocessing learned/fitted from train only when applicable

baseline.name: CLAHE/bilateral optional preprocessing + morphology or compact U-Net
six_hour_plan: start with threshold/morphology and basic U-Net
use Dice/BCE or focal only if class imbalance requires it
evaluate per-image/borehole IoU, F1, recall, precision and failure cases
baseline.why: simple, fast and reveals whether ResNet/ASPP/attention complexity is actually needed

author_route.method: CLAHE + bilateral + Sobel, improved U-Net with ResNet50, ASPP and attention gating
why_fit: pretrained encoder may help if labels are limited
attention gate can suppress structured background features
author_route.evidence_boundary: reported 98.7% Accuracy/73.1% IoU/84.8% F1, but independent split, loss implementation and several engineering claims are not traceable in printed appendix.

major_alternatives.why_can_work: strong segmentation baseline with fewer moving parts
major_alternatives.when_prefer: small/medium labeled dataset and thin foreground imbalance
enough independent images and stable holdout gain over U-Net
very small labels or urgent six-hour path

not_recommended.model: large vision transformer/foundation fine-tune by default
not_recommended.why_not_now: data independence/sample count not established; high tuning cost
adjacent pixels/patches from same borehole image leak texture and fracture identity

switch_conditions: upgrade beyond U-Net only with held-out-borehole gain in IoU/F1
if labels are scarce prefer classical/compact model plus active labeling
if domain shifts by borehole/geology, prioritize grouped validation/domain robustness over architecture depth

Q2.problem_type_and_essence: cluster connected fracture fragments and fit physically constrained periodic traces

input_target_constraints.input: binary fracture masks/centerlines and mm-per-pixel scale
input_target_constraints.objective: stable physically plausible fit with uncertainty/reject status
input_target_constraints.independent_evaluation_unit: one physical fracture trace with image provenance
hard_constraints: period tied to borehole circumference when task specifies
grouping must not merge distinct crossing traces

baseline.name: connected components + proximity/orientation merge + skeleton centerline + bounded robust least_squares with fixed P
six_hour_plan: merge fragments using endpoint distance + tangent/orientation compatibility
fit sine with fixed circumference period using Huber/soft-L1 least_squares
report R²/RMSE and reject implausible amplitude/centerline
baseline.why: matches physics and exposes failures; no need for GP/deep model

author_route.method: connected regions + DBSCAN + skeleton + fixed-period sinusoid; prose additionally claims frequency init, LM, RANSAC, Huber/iterative robust refinements
why_fit: fixed period uses known cylindrical geometry
robust fit can mitigate outliers and broken traces
author_route.evidence_boundary: printed code visibly uses centroid DBSCAN and scipy least_squares; claimed RANSAC/Huber/IRLS chain is not visible. DBSCAN radius/earlier distance-threshold semantics also drift.

major_alternatives.why_can_work: detects multiple curves before point assignment
major_alternatives.when_prefer: crossing/overlapping traces where connected components fail

not_recommended.why_not_now: poor periodic extrapolation and weak physical meaning
paper itself contains extreme amplitude/low-R² cases showing need for rejection

switch_conditions: if residuals are multimodal/crossing, solve assignment and fitting jointly
if fixed circumference period is violated by data acquisition geometry, reopen period with strong bounds and model selection
reject rather than force sine when goodness/plausibility gates fail

Q3.problem_type_and_essence: convert an extracted calibrated fracture profile to a stable roughness descriptor/JRC under sampling uncertainty

input_target_constraints.decision: sampling scheme, Z2 and JRC estimate
input_target_constraints.objective: roughness estimate stable to resolution/noise and physically interpretable

baseline.name: contour extraction + mild smoothing + equal arc-length sampling sensitivity + task-given Z2/JRC formula
six_hour_plan: compute JRC over several sampling densities/smoothing levels
baseline.why: directly answers task and makes sampling dependence visible

author_route.method: multi-scale LoG attention fusion + equal/curvature-weighted sampling + Z2→JRC + segmented JRC
why_fit: curvature-weighted sampling can preserve sharp local changes
multi-scale edge cues can help complex boundaries
author_route.evidence_boundary: printed appendix starts from JSON/binary contours and does not implement headline LoG-attention path; it multiplies Z2 by image-specific SCALE_FACTORS and clips JRC to 0..20.

major_alternatives.why_can_work: quantifies heterogeneity instead of one scalar

not_recommended.model: per-image fudge scale to force JRC range
claim area causes high JRC from clipped cross-sectional association
not_recommended.why_not_now: association plus ceiling saturation cannot establish causal/physical effect

switch_conditions: if task mandates standard sampling, keep standard for primary result and use curvature sampling as sensitivity
if many values hit 20, report saturation and analyze raw Z2 rather than infer correlations from clipped JRC

Q4.problem_type_and_essence: spatial network inference and value-of-information drilling recommendation under substantial epistemic uncertainty

input_target_constraints.input: borehole coordinates/depths + fracture geometry/JRC + upstream uncertainty
input_target_constraints.decision: pairwise compatibility/connectivity, 3D graph and three new borehole locations
input_target_constraints.objective: useful, robust information gain/coverage under engineering constraints
input_target_constraints.independent_evaluation_unit: borehole network/scenario, not individual pair treated as iid
hard_constraints: scores called probabilities need calibration or must be labeled heuristic compatibility

baseline.name: geometry-based compatibility score + threshold sensitivity + uncertainty map + greedy maximin/expected-coverage drilling
six_hour_plan: bootstrap/Monte Carlo upstream parameters to obtain connection uncertainty
rank candidate holes by expected uncertainty reduction/coverage with engineering feasibility
baseline.why: transparent and avoids pretending hand-set weighted scores are calibrated probabilities

author_route.method: weighted exponential Pgeo + sigmoid JRC correction + synergy bonus; CV+entropy uncertainty; AHP then projection-pursuit improved GA for drilling ranking
author_route.evidence_boundary: many constants are hand-set without independent calibration; appendix shows inconsistent entropy implementations and omits PPIGA code; AHP pairwise/CR is not actually demonstrated; 9.95 vs 8.40 is an endogenous score comparison.

major_alternatives.why_can_work: can calibrate uncertainty and propagate measurement error

major_alternatives.model: Gaussian process/geostatistical field + expected information gain

major_alternatives.why_can_work: transparent when probabilities cannot be calibrated
major_alternatives.when_prefer: small candidate set and expert tradeoffs

not_recommended.model: optimize weights then validate by the optimized score itself
call weighted compatibility a probability without calibration
not_recommended.why_not_now: numeric 0..1 range alone does not confer probabilistic meaning

switch_conditions: use Bayesian/geostatistical model when labeled spatial evidence supports calibration
use robust MCDA when only preferences are defensible
new-hole recommendation must be tested by held-out/synthetic recovery or expected information gain, not only higher composite score
